name: Stormbringer: Wrath of Al'Akir extends Unshackle when Static is depleted (#1772)

steps.label: SETUP: the Air Elemental Unshackle transforms is present
SETUP: Unshackle applied its aura to the Air Elemental
BASELINE: Unshackle lasts its own 15000 ms (SpellDuration 8) without the passive
SETUP: Unshackle depleted the 50 Static it costs, leaving 50 of 100

DISCRIMINATING: depleting Static with Wrath of Al'Akir known adds 300835's +3000 ms (EffectBasePoints[0] 2999 + EffectDieSides[0] 1) to Unshackle, so the remaining duration rises instead of ticking down

contract: #1772: Wrath of Al'Akir (300834) reads "Depleting Static extends the duration of your Unshackle by $/1000;300835S1 sec", i.e. 3 sec, because its proc payload 300835 carries two SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_AURA_DURATION effects with EffectMiscValue 706625 and EffectBasePoints 2999 + EffectDieSides 1 = +3000 ms, the first of them on TARGET_UNIT_PET where Unshackle's aura lives. Unshackle (706625) has DurationIndex 8 = 15000 ms and costs 50 Static; Tailwind (804035) costs 20 more. Static is spent by module resource code, not by a native proc event, so the payload has to be cast from the depletion site itself.
